_meta.filter: /^(components-sidepanel|patterns-create-flows-createsidepanel|preview-pageheader|components-editinplace|components-fullpageerror|components-onboarding-interstitialscreen|components-optionstile|components-useravatar|utilities-scrollgradient|preview-candidate-bignumber|patterns-coachmark|preview-onboarding-coachmark)/ -- 46 of 426 stories. WIDENED 2026-08-31 from the 21-story sidepanel/pageheader filter, to cover the EIGHT COMPONENTS CARBON 1.114 ADDED (big-number, coachmark, EditInPlace, FullPageError, InterstitialScreen, OptionsTile, scroll-gradient, user-avatar), which docs/inventory.md had rowed with no markup reference to diff against. MANDATORY on this origin; the default /./ harvests all 426 and many die on the ibm-products Storybook's own chromatic/isChromatic module error, which sends 100+ dead stories to a sequential retry the run never finishes. deprecated-coachmark-* is EXCLUDED deliberately -- capturing deprecated markup is worse than capturing none.
_meta.versionNote: This origin has no single "Carbon version" and carbonVersion is therefore NOT written -- the same decision carbon-react-*.json made when it replaced that field with named ones. @carbon/ibm-products 2.97.0 is the release the Storybook welcome page names; the rest are READ FROM /project.json on the same origin (knownPackages.uiLibraryPackages), not assumed. They are RANGES, because that is what ibm-products declares -- the cds-- classes here are attributable only to a range, never to one @carbon/react build. Note carbonStyles ^1.110.1 is BELOW the 1.114.0 this repo compiles, so a cds-- divergence between these captures and carbon-react-*.json (which record 1.115.0 / 1.114.0) can be Carbon moving rather than a fault here.
_meta.settle:
SETTLE_MAX_MS 15000, CONCURRENCY 2 on this run, and BOTH the failure count and the TREES improved. 0 of 46 stories failed, against 21 of 21 filed (empty) on the first pass of the previous capture at SETTLE_MAX_MS 6000 / CONCURRENCY 3.

MORE IMPORTANTLY, THE OLD CAPTURE WAS SILENTLY INCOMPLETE, and nothing reported it. 14 of the 21 previously-committed stories are byte-identical here; SEVEN preview-pageheader stories gained DOM. The cause is measured, not guessed: c4p--truncated-text measures its own overflow and only THEN renders a tooltip trigger, so at 6s the capture recorded a bare span.c4p--truncated-text__text-content and at 15s it records that span inside button.c4p--truncated-text__tooltip-trigger and the full cds--popover-container / cds--tooltip chrome Carbon wraps it in. A capture that reports no failures can still be an early frame.

Measured 2026-08-31, one iframe at a time: components-sidepanel--slide-over first paints a classed element at 4.4s, preview-pageheader--default at 6.0s -- both right at the old 6000 ceiling, which is why that ceiling produced whole-run (empty) results AND partial trees. An (empty) on this origin is a TIMING result, never the chromatic/isChromatic module error, which hits stories the FILTER already excludes.

OPEN QUESTION THIS RAISES FOR THE OTHER FILE: docs/carbon-react-dom.json's 505 stories were captured at SETTLE_MAX_MS 6000 too. react.carbondesignsystem.com is a much faster origin -- the full run measures 84s for 505 stories -- so the same partial-tree risk is far lower there, but it has not been tested.
